reader_summary.overview: Avi is a Professor at the University of Toronto’s Rotman School of Management, the Rotman Chair in Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare. His most recent book, Power and Prediction, is probably the best piece of content I have read in explaining how AI may reshape business models, systems. We recorded this before GPT-4’s release last week which, if anything, makes Avi’s ideas on AI’s impact all the more poignant.
